purpose: Cheap-first computational closure plan for literature gaps that still affect ranking, calibration, or observability.

targets.gap: No direct matrix-quantitative retention curve for FFT/MFT as browning progresses in soy or pea.
targets.cheap_first_method: severity-linked surrogate in observable projection calibrated against Hofmann 2001 directionality and benchmark-visible sulfur suppression
targets.upgrade_method: offline DFT or semiempirical microcluster screening only if the surrogate fails to preserve observed sulfur ranking across benchmark families
targets.acceptance_signal: heated-matrix sulfur predictions remain below free-system sulfur outputs while preserving meaty ranking order

targets.gap: Literature lacks direct barrier-resolved selectivity map explaining furfural overshoot versus MFT yield under plant-matrix conditions.
targets.cheap_first_method: quality constraint on MFT/furfural ratio plus sensitivity ranking of sulfur-branch barriers
targets.upgrade_method: targeted DFT refinement of furfural-forming dehydration versus thiol-addition branch if optimizer still exploits furfural-heavy solutions
targets.acceptance_signal: top-ranked meaty solutions sustain sulfur targets without extreme furfural inflation

targets.gap: Nishimura 2024 confirms peptide-bound cysteine reactivity but not absolute pathway weights.
targets.cheap_first_method: peptide-reactivity prior or precursor multiplier tied to hydrolysate process state
targets.upgrade_method: semiempirical conformer ranking before any DFT, escalating only if peptide systems become benchmark-critical
targets.acceptance_signal: hydrolysate systems shift sulfur ranking in the right direction without breaking free-amino-acid benchmarks

targets.gap: Hexanal and related off-flavour release is process-state dependent and only partially anchored in the current literature.
targets.cheap_first_method: compound-specific process-state calibration entries and reversible headspace release factors
targets.upgrade_method: binding free-energy calculations only if observable error remains benchmark-visible after calibration
targets.acceptance_signal: heated soy adverse markers attenuate in the right direction while ambient soy baselines stay anchored

targets.gap: A small number of sulfur-branch proton-transfer steps are known xTB weak points and may govern ranking uncertainty.
targets.cheap_first_method: no new runtime model; only triage and watchlist
targets.upgrade_method: explicit-solvent offline DFT microcluster jobs via the selective triage contract
targets.acceptance_signal: only promoted if sensitivity analysis shows a benchmark-visible ranking change

targets.gap: Family 11: Competitive kinetics of hexanal quenching by Maillard radicals is missing direct anchors.
targets.cheap_first_method: MACE-OFF24 screening then xTB-derived GFN2 barriers
targets.upgrade_method: selective_dft_anchor (wB97M-V) for the transition state refinement
targets.acceptance_signal: hexanal suppression is non-zero in the presence of cysteine-derived radicals

targets.gap: Family 13: Absolute rates for polyphenol quinone capping of cysteine in high-moisture matrices.
targets.cheap_first_method: Literature transfer from simple analogue plus xTB triage
targets.upgrade_method: DFT refinement of the Michael addition TS in aqueous microclusters
targets.acceptance_signal: Cys depletion rate correlates with quinone load in simulated pea juice

targets.gap: Family 14: Arrhenius parameters for dehydroascorbic acid ring-opening into 3-deoxythreosone.
targets.cheap_first_method: Balanced dehydroascorbic-acid hydration/ring-opening xTB seed plus HCW literature anchor retained as the bounded Family 14 surrogate until selective DFT lands
targets.upgrade_method: DFT-based barrier refinement if AA-contributed browning dominates during extrusion
targets.acceptance_signal: AA-derived dicarbonyl yield matches molar glucose equivalence benchmarks
targets.method: Family 14 HCW literature surrogate (bounded upstream dicarbonyl source)
targets.surrogate_reaction: Dehydroascorbic-acid ring opening and hydration treated as a bounded upstream source of reactive dicarbonyl pressure rather than as a validated elementary xTB endpoint.
targets.surrogate_assumption: Assumes the Family 14 runtime lane is still controlled by the HCW-derived effective barrier until selective DFT confirms or narrows the balanced DHAA-plus-water surrogate pair.
targets.surrogate_note: Keep the literature-backed Family 14 source term as the bounded calibration authority while the regenerated balanced xTB pair is advanced through selective DFT.

targets.gap: Family 15: Phospholipid-amine interfacial PE Schiff base — Ea=92.9 kJ/mol from SLR 15.
targets.cheap_first_method: SLR 15 literature Ea=92.9 kJ/mol as literature_derived_transfer prior
targets.upgrade_method: wB97M-V//r2SCAN-3c DFT validation of the PE-glucose condensation TS
targets.acceptance_signal: Model explains sugar disappearance in lecithin-heavy extrudates; DFT validates literature Ea

targets.gap: Family 15: PE Amadori rearrangement — Ea=82.9 kJ/mol from SLR 15.
targets.cheap_first_method: SLR 15 literature Ea=82.9 kJ/mol as literature_derived_transfer prior
targets.upgrade_method: wB97M-V//r2SCAN-3c DFT validation of the PE-Amadori 1,2-proton shift
targets.acceptance_signal: PE-Amadori yield is consistent with sugar depletion experiments in model PE-sugar systems

targets.gap: Family 16: Radical-scavenging capacity of HMW melanoidins for sulfur volatiles.
targets.cheap_first_method: trapping burden modifier using pseudo-zero-order accumulation
targets.upgrade_method: DFT screening of sulfur-radical addition to melanoidin fragment proxies
targets.acceptance_signal: sulfur volatile loss matches observed IC50 in spiked matrix experiments

targets.gap: Family 12: Absolute formation kinetics for lysinoalanine under alkaline HME conditions.
targets.cheap_first_method: Balanced dehydroalanine-plus-lysine xTB seed, with the DHA_Crosslinking family rule retained as the bounded fallback until selective DFT lands
targets.upgrade_method: selective_dft_anchor for absolute yield prediction in extrusion
targets.acceptance_signal: LAL yield matches masked literature anchors from safety registries
targets.surrogate_reaction: Dehydroalanine plus lysine epsilon-amine Michael addition to form lysinoalanine.
targets.surrogate_assumption: Assumes dehydroalanine has already formed by beta-elimination; the balanced Michael-addition pair can now be screened with xTB, but the family rule remains the bounded authority until selective DFT is written back.
targets.surrogate_note: Keep the repo's DHA_Crosslinking family rule as fallback authority while the regenerated balanced pair advances through xTB and selective DFT.
